posts.name: Roger the Alien
posts.cooked:
I just want to share this lovely moment with you:

I played using Santa Guise, Stuntman and Benchmark vs. Wager Master. 

It was the turn of Guise and he had a lot of ongoings out which were destroyed at the beginning of his turn. One of that cards was „Uh, Yeah, I‘m that guy!“ which copied all ongoings of >whom may I have chosen< ... correct, it was Stuntman. One of the cards he copied was „Steal the scene“ which got destroyed which led to the following situation: He has stolen his own scene, this silly, hilarious, little guy. 

Right after that „Steal the scene“ of Stuntman triggered. It was like „I will have the last word“ and he dealt the finishing blow.

posts.cooked:
Well, Dark Watch Mr. Fixer also loves both of them ;P

Stuntman likes to get ongoings destroyed and Benchmark has also a lot of them and may exceed his limit of software cards by 1, just destroy one of them before it‘s his turn again. Aside from this fact, Benchmark has a lot of possibilities to play cards and get them back.

posts.cooked:
Hello, could somebody please explain me the following situation:

Guise copied this ongoings from Stuntman: https://imgur.com/a/LQrIKne

After the environment played a card Stuntman could destroy L‘Embuscade or Guise could destroy Uh, Yeah, I‘m that guy!: https://imgur.com/a/CTDIfRk

I decided to destroy Uh, Yeah, I‘m that guy!: https://imgur.com/a/fAuwCjb

My expectation was that the 4 ongoings which were copied would trigger their effects beginning from the first card that entered play till the last card card that entered play:

1. No time to bleed: Draw a card and use a power

2. Coute que coute: Draw a card

3. L‘Embuscade: Deal 5 damage or use a power

4. Dramatic cliffhanger: Draw a card, play a card, use a power. I may choose the order.

 

In fact this happened:

I drew a card: https://imgur.com/a/CsE0CCc –> 2. Coute que coute

https://imgur.com/a/uEixzgU –> 4. Dramatic cliffhanger

https://imgur.com/a/1jNPhYI –> 3. L‘Embuscade

I drew a card and Guise tried to use a power: https://imgur.com/a/o1ltIQO and https://imgur.com/a/FSQzRBj –> 1. No time to bleed

Why was this order chosen?

Although my heroes were at low healt and Gloomweaver at almost 50 health plus he had some cards in play and he was gonna to restore 100 health on his back side... I easily won by the way^^ The combination of this 3 heroes really rocked and was pretty fun.
